# Evaluation

This folder contains documentation on the assessment of organizational development goals and performance metrics within the corpus. It currently focuses on a specific evaluation of Indikator 2, explicitly recording that the development target of 90% or higher was not met, which demonstrates the transparent tracking of performance shortfalls in the source material.

## Pages

- [[evaluation|Evaluation]] — Assesses organizational development goals and performance metrics, specifically documenting the failure to meet the 90% target for Indikator 2.
